population_estimation.interpretation: population-estimation sample of observed reco.nz 3x3 records; source selection bias remains outside this design

coverage_analysis.interpretation: coverage-seeking analysis sample; not frequency-representative and must not be used with unweighted population claims

linkage_support.A_EXACT: requires independently proved external official-attempt identity; never granted from reco index metadata alone
linkage_support.B_STRONG_SUPPORT: competition nonblank and solver/date/result/puzzle present and full reco-side linkage tuple unique within source population; still not an external match
linkage_support.C_CANDIDATE: required fields present but tuple nonunique, or other material ambiguity remains
linkage_support.U_UNRESOLVED: competition absent or required linkage support absent
